trip.title: Kashmir Signature Escape
trip.subtitle: A curated 6-day private journey through Srinagar, Gulmarg, and Pahalgam

vehicle.name: Toyota Innova Crysta
vehicle.note: Private vehicle with driver for airport transfers, sightseeing, and intercity movement.

days.title: Arrival in Srinagar
days.summary: Airport pickup, hotel check-in, Dal Lake shikara ride, and an easy evening by the boulevard.

days.title: Srinagar Gardens and Old City
days.summary: A slow day across Nishat, Shalimar, Chashme Shahi, and a short old-city craft trail.

days.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg
days.summary: Drive through Tangmarg to Gulmarg, settle into the resort, and visit the gondola base area.

days.title: Gulmarg Leisure Day
days.summary: A flexible day for gondola phase one, short trails, photography, and resort time.

days.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam
days.summary: Scenic drive to Pahalgam with saffron fields and river valley views en route.

days.title: Pahalgam Valleys and Departure
days.summary: Visit Betaab Valley or Aru Valley before returning to Srinagar airport.

inclusions: Private vehicle with driver throughout the trip
Daily breakfast and selected dinners as mentioned
Airport pickup and drop in Srinagar
exclusions: Gondola tickets, pony rides, union cabs, and local activity charges
Lunches, personal expenses, and room service
terms: Rooms are subject to availability at the time of confirmation.
Prices may change during peak dates, weather disruptions, or hotel inventory changes.
Local union transport rules may apply in Gulmarg, Pahalgam, and Sonamarg.
